description: Draft a message to the dealer about one car for the shopper to review: it asks about availability, the out-the-door price with fees, add-ons and history. Returns the draft text only. Nothing is sent to the dealer. Ask the shopper before calling this, and use only the name and contact they gave you.

contact.description: Email or mobile number the shopper wants answers sent to, as they gave it.

first_name.description: The shopper's first name, as they gave it.

note.description: Anything else the shopper wants asked, in their words.

questions.description: What to ask. Default: availability and out-the-door price.

name: draft_dealer_message
title: Draft a message to the dealer
